claims.text: A grid reference gives the easting first, read along the bottom of the map, then the northing, read up the side; a six-figure reference adds a third figure to each for the tenths across the square.

verification.method: Authored originally for the 0460 structural exemplar under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: A compass direction is a point of the compass, such as north-east; a bearing is an angle in degrees measured clockwise from grid north.

claims.text: On a map of scale 1:50 000, 1 cm on the map is 0.5 km on the ground, so a distance in centimetres is multiplied by 0.5 to give kilometres.
